Magimagine is a tool designed as a website to create stories.
A story can take many forms including a novel, a comic book, a movie, a poem, or a biography.
The website proposes the creation of a story through five stages of development: Brainstorm, Realization, Structuring, Production, and Publication.
The Brainstorm stage is for accumulating ideas, providing basic tools to make a list and classify ideas.
The Realization stage allows users to create useful objects for their story, such as characters, locations, groups, races, and languages.
In the Realization stage, links can be established between objects to ensure coherence in the story.
The Structuring stage is used to structure the story and establish events on a timeline.
The Structuring stage adds a notion of time among the objects produced in the Realization stage.
At the end of the Structuring stage, it will be possible to determine the location of a character or an object at a specific time.
Magimagine allows users to determine the location of a character or an object at a specific time.
The user can know when a character dies and determine its age using Magimagine.
